rows.name: onChange
rows.description: handle the input text change (mandatory since result list is a slot).

rows.name: inputText
rows.description: the value of the search input (mandatory since result list is a slot).

rows.name: clearButtonProps
rows.description: Add additional functionality to the clear button.

rows.name: backButtonProps
rows.description: Add functionality on back button for small screens.

rows.name: focusOnInput
rows.description: Handle the item from the result list you want to focus on.

rows.name: resultList
rows.description: Select between the resultList component provided or add your own custom component.

rows.name: setListVisible
rows.description: Controls if the items list is visible or not (mandatory since result list is a slot).

rows.name: isListVisible
rows.description: shows if the items list is visible or not (mandatory since result list is a slot).

rows.name: listId
rows.description: The unique id of the list. It creates a connections between the search input with the items list (mandatory since result list is a slot).

rows.name: inputAriaLabel
rows.description: The aria label for the input field.

rows.name: searchIcon
rows.description: Search Icon. If nothing is set, the default icon will be used.
